issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the principal appellant contradicted herself about the date of the first complaint
issues.applicant_position: Shock explains the misstatement; 'next day' could mean two days later, so it is not a contradiction.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_text: The appellant contradicted herself; the RPD gave her a chance to clarify and properly drew a negative inference.

issues.issue: Whether the complaint's omission of the spouse's work-related motive was properly weighed
issues.applicant_position: The mother could not know what the husband told police; he must have disclosed the motive, which police did not note.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_text: The omitted motive is not a mere detail; the RPD properly assessed the complaint's omission.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD correctly assessed the children's testimony about the criminals
issues.applicant_position: RPD focused on minor details; traumatic voices and faces are hard to recall, and stress of testifying was ignored.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_text: RPD correctly assessed the children's credibility; their accounts contradicted the mother and the BOC Form.

issues.issue: Whether the spouse's email has probative value
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored the rocky relationship; the email does not prove the spouse told her by phone about the criminals.
issues.result_text: RPD correctly found the email has no probative value.

issues.issue: Whether the family's conduct after the second home invasion is consistent with a genuine fear
issues.applicant_position: Children would not count days as the RPD asked; the family's behaviour was consistent with common thefts.
issues.result_text: The RPD's finding that the family did not act consistently with the seriousness of the situation is founded.

issues.issue: Whether the appellants show a well-founded fear under section 96 (subjective and objective components)
issues.applicant_position: Must be considered refugees if subjective and objective components are met, regardless of credibility.
issues.result_text: The RPD considered all elements and properly weighed the evidence; the appellants did not meet their burden.
